verdict.rationale: Mesh has a broad documented API, backed by a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema, that covers customer creation and screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring configuration, case audit trails, exports, IAM roles and transaction processing. The docs also explicitly state that cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated via either the web app or the API. However, API credentials are documented as generated in the web application, and no evidence shows parity for other UI functions such as configuring the risk-score equation or screening configurations. missing for 10: explicit documented UI/API parity guarantee, API-based credential and access management, API coverage of risk-scoring and screening-configuration setup, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
